changelog:
Initial release of tap-trust-audit (v1.0.0):

- Introduces a trust audit protocol with reputation-only verification for agents.
- Supports permanent Agent ID with Ed25519 public key.
- Implements 5/7 peer attestation and eigenTrust reputation updates every 6 hours.
- Features Open Claw auto-verification and boot-hash tamper detection.
- Installation via single bash command; open source on GitHub.
summary: Trust Audit Protocol - Reputation-only verification for agents
